title: E17 same-tick win/lose precedence never collision-tested — the named pin only proves the mechanism
detail: The named same-tick pin never constructs the collision — the fixture loses at ~510, 2490 ticks before the 3000 window end, so win_lose_eval's intra-tick skip after a meter Run_Lost is unexercised.
recommended_fix: Craft the collision: set meter_pct so the 2/tick drain empties exactly at tick 3000 (surge_done latched), then assert one Run_Lost, no Run_Won, tick frozen at 3000.

title: E16 drain min-branch (severity below the cap) has no rate assertion
detail: Every drain-rate assertion demands delta == 2 (max(1,2)=2; severity 5 capped at 2). The severity-below-cap rate (email draining alone at 1/tick) executes in the fixture's ~390–404 band but is never asserted — a cap-always drain would pass all tests and goldens.
recommended_fix: Assert delta == 1 per tick over the email-only drain band (~390–404) in test_health_drain_max_not_sum_e16, before streaming's grace expires.

title: Surge-win gate negative branches (sub-threshold, zero-completion) never execute with the gate enabled
detail: The below-threshold test's run dies from the meter at ~255, so win_lose_eval's `uptime >= surge_win_pct` false branch and its `total > 0` guard never execute with the gate enabled; a sub-90% live-meter window end is untested.
recommended_fix: Add a fixture sustaining 10–30% drops (below breach tolerance, above win threshold) asserting window-end behaviour with a live meter; enable surge_win_pct in the E24 zero-demand test.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: win (won_tick==3000 + health_win golden), lose (empty_run_lost_e17 + drain pins + health_lose golden), retry (restart_clean), no-soft-lock (property). P1 ~83%: E16/E17/E30 mostly pinned; same-tick collision, severity-below-cap rate, and win-gate negatives uncovered. Overall ~87%.
recommended_fix: Add the three boundary tests — same-tick win/lose collision, email-only 1/tick drain, sub-threshold live-meter window end — to push P1 to 90%+.
